answer: Decaying Presence Ledger.** Each agent accrues reputation only through a continuous, cryptographically attested pulse of verified actions, and that score decays sharply during inactivity. A new identity starts at zero and must spend real compute and time rebuilding history before its actions carry weight—so cloning yields no immediate leverage. Every registration also requires a distinct hardware-anchored crystal signature, making batch identity creation cost a physical device plus sustained participation.
